system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: cloud-armor-policy
    type: compute.v1.securityPolicy
    properties:
      description: Cloud Armor security policy
      rules:
        - action: deny
          preview: false
          priority: 1000
          match:
            config:
              srcIpRanges:
                - '*'
          description: Block traffic from specific countries
          ipBlock:
            destinations:
              - '*'
            sources:
              - 'country_code:CN'
              - 'country_code:RU'
        - action: rateBasedBan
          preview: false
          priority: 2000
          match:
            config:
              srcIpRanges:
                - '*'
          description: Rate limit requests per IP
          rateLimit:
            rateLimitThreshold:
              count: 100
              intervalSec: 60
            banThreshold:
              count: 1000
              intervalSec: 3600
            banDurationSec: 3600
          ipBlock:
            destinations:
              - '*'
            sources:
              - '*'
      enabled: true

  - name: backend-service
    type: compute.v1.backendService
    properties:
      description: Backend service
      backends:
        - group: $(ref.instance-group.selfLink)
      enableCDN: false
      securityPolicy:
        - $(ref.cloud-armor-policy.selfLink)

  - name: instance-group
    type: compute.v1.instanceGroupManager
    properties:
      description: Instance group
      instanceTemplate: $(ref.instance-template.selfLink)
      targetSize: 1

  - name: instance-template
    type: compute.v1.instanceTemplate
    properties:
      description: Instance template
      properties:
        machineType: f1-micro
        disks:
          - deviceName: boot
            type: PERSISTENT
            boot: true
            initializeParams:
              diskSizeGb: 10
              sourceImage: projects/debian-cloud/global/images/debian-11-bullseye-v20230214
        networkInterfaces:
          - accessConfigs:
              - name: External NAT
                type: ONE_TO_ONE_NAT
            network: $(ref.network.selfLink)
        tags:
          - http-server
          - https-server

  - name: network
    type: compute.v1.network
    properties:
      description: Network
      autoCreateSubnetworks: true

  - name: firewall-rule
    type: compute.v1.firewall
    properties:
      description: Firewall rule
      network: $(ref.network.selfLink)
      sourceRanges:
        - 0.0.0.0/0
      allowed:
        - IPProtocol: TCP
          ports:
            - 80
            - 443
      targetTags:
        - http-server
        - https-server

outputs:
  - name: cloud-armor-policy
    value: $(ref.cloud-armor-policy.selfLink)
